jobs.title: Freelance Trainer - SAP MM - immediate start
jobs.description: As SAP People to Work training partner, we are launching the SAP Procurement & Sales Management Program. This innovative initiative aims to equip aspiring professionals with the Consultant skills and knowledge required to excel in the realm of Sourcing and Procurement and Sales. We are currently in search of a full-time MM Trainer , a crucial role focused on the delivery and teaching of the program, to ensure that our participants are fully equipped for prosperous careers as SAP MM Consultants. Tasks Train and support the students in their daily sessions. Engage in close collaboration with internal teams and our partner, SAP, to pinpoint precise educational needs and adapt teaching content and methods to meet these requirements. Regularly update and refine teaching materials to incorporate the latest developments and insights in SAP technology, enhancing the educational value for students. Work in harmony with other teachers to provide a unified and enriching educational experience, guaranteeing a well-rounded learning journey for all participants. Requirements Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; Master's degree is a plus. Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP, specifically in MM. Proven track record as a trainer is a must, specifically training Consultants. Deep understanding of SAP and familiarity with industry best practices. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts in a clear and engaging manner. Strong team player, capable of collaborating effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders. Adaptive and responsive to feedback, with the ability to adapt to evolving program requirements. Benefits Opportunity to be part of a groundbreaking initiative in partnership with SAP. Competitive compensation package. Dynamic and inclusive work environment. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
